title: Multiplying and dividing decimals by 10 and 100

blocks.content: Multiplying or dividing a decimal by 10 or 100 is quick once you know the trick: you just slide the decimal point.
To multiply a decimal by 10, move the decimal point one place to the RIGHT; by 100, move it two places right.

steps: Move the point one place right.

blocks.explain: Moving the point one place right turns 3.4 into 34.
blocks.rule: To multiply by 10 move the point one place right; by 100 move it two places right.

blocks.content: To divide a decimal by 10, move the decimal point one place to the LEFT; by 100, move it two places left.

blocks.explain: Moving the point one place left turns 34 into 3.4.
blocks.rule: To divide by 10 move the point one place left; by 100 move it two places left.

blocks.content: Times 10 or 100 slides the point right; divide by 10 or 100 slides it left. Count the zeros to count the places. Let's practise!
